Aleksandr ANTONCHENKOV
e: abtc@mail.com
c: 07888 979711
Key technical skills: C++, Rust, HFT, ULL, Tech/Team Leadership
Leading Software Engineer with 18+ years of experience (10+ years in investment banking/
HFT/ULL) focused on developing complicated mission critical systems in C++.
Strong knowledge of networking, multithreading and ULL techniques. Self-motivated individual
contributor and cooperative team player. Experience of managing and leading cross-functional
and multi-national teams (up to 35 people).
Ergonia.io
Proprietary Trading [ Feb 2023 - present ]
Ergonia is a DRW spin-off focusing on proprietary trading opportunities on CeFi/DeFi crypto
space, mainly focusing on market making and arbitrage. As a Founding Trading Systems
Engineer I provide technical solutions for trading operations focusing mainly on market data
and execution. In that capacity I’ve introduced frameworks for market data and execution
connectors and implemented Bybit and OKX execution and Bybit, OKX, Binance and Coinbase
market data connectors; introduced end-to-end latency measurements service; implemented
order management service; participated in prototyping of Etherium Builder; implemented funds
rebalancing strategy; integrated system with Cumberland CHIP market data platform and
Cumberland OTC quoting.
GSR
Front Ofﬁce [ Oct 2021 - Nov 2022 ]
Front Ofﬁce team owns proprietary C++ trading/research framework, core business product. The
framework is a set of building blocks for building strategies for spot and derivatives trading. As a
Principal/Leading Engineer I do end-to-end development of new features (various services
for distribution of centralised computations, indices, market data processing, risk checks, etc);
interact with quant teams for clariﬁcation of new features requirements; provide design,
implementation and integration; interact with other teams in joint efforts to move forward ﬁrm
wide technology initiatives; push on cultural shifts to make things right - unit testing,
integration testing, code coverage reporting, performance testing, code reviews, coding style;
lead sub-teams on per project basis.
Goldman Sachs
FICC SMM Core [ Feb 2019 - Sep 2021 ]
FICC SMM Core team is a proprietary connectivity platform written in C++ and Java (with
minor inclusion of Python and Lua) supports 50+ venues.
I joined team as a Senior Developer (ED) and have been focusing on supporting and developing
market data and trading connectors. My main contributions to in that role are:
* MOEX/Shanghai/Shenzhen/Yieldbroker/FastMatch/GDAX/T.Reuters SBE/Euronext/
SIX/CBOE/Eurex (T7)/ICE/LME/MTS Repo/EPEX (M7) market data connectors and
mandatory upgrades;
* ICE/CFE/Hotspot trading connectors and mandatory upgrades;
* 2 new engines for market data ﬂow proposed in framework (common) code;
* Nanosecond timestamp support added across capture/replay functionality, including hardware
time stamping for both native and Onload stacks;
* Latency measurement tooling introduced;

* FAST parser improvements for ﬂexible / error tolerant processing.
Deutsche Bank
Quantum [ Oct 2013 - Feb 2019 ]
Quantum project is ULL/HFT proprietary connectivity platform in C++ being developed by
distributed team of developers, covers 40+ exchanges, provides full stack of connectivity ﬂows.
I joined team as an Engineer (AV P) and have been focusing on framework development.
After 2 years I took leadership over the team (up to 35 developers) and was promoted to
Leading Engineer (VP). My responsibilities included hiring people (team head count expanded
from 6 to 35 people during my time), people management, project management and technical
leadership focusing on Platform features development, MiFIDII regulation compliance and
gateway frameworks development. In that role my achievements are:
* Project platform made MiFID II compliant:
+ Designed and implemented MiFID II record keeping solution;
+ Implemented mandatory upgrades for MTS, Eurex and BTec trading connectors.
* Frameworks introduced:
+ DropCopy gateway framework;
+ FIX gateway framework;
+ DropCopy ﬂow normalisation (including end-to-end integration with upstreams).
Rambler [ Aug 2008 - Sep 2013 ]
My primary role as a Senior Developer was to lead team (up to 5 developers) on different
projects in C++.
* Multi-threaded system for fetching e-mail messages from foreign services (high load prepared,
clusterised and scalable):
+ Mysql sharded storage for user proﬁles and messages;
+ Backend server for multithreaded distributed downloading.
* Mail search subsystem based on partner search engine (using beanstalkd, multi-threaded
daemons, high load prepared, clusterised and scalable):
+ Implemented infrastructure and request/response daemon;
* Multi-threaded system for feature snippets on SERP (C++11, multi-threading, high loaded,
scalable) including:
+ Python framework for thematic/service search developed (python, sphinx, gunicorn, mysql).
+ Full text search for lenta.ru, motor.ru, news.rambler.ru, eda.ru, top100.ru released based on
customised Sphynx open-source engine.
* Crawler subsystem (data retrieval subsystem of the search engine):
+ Multi-thread data processing RSS feeds crawler designed implemented (new feature allowed
to support RSS feeds);
+ Data retrieval subsystem improved (crawler capacity is doubled), proxy server and search
daemon code refactored.
SUP Fabrik [ Dec 2006 - Sep 2008 ]
My primary role was Software Engineer in team developing ad system for LiveJournal.com in
C++. After release in production in has been running for 7 years with nearly zero maintenance
cost.
My personal contributions were:
* User proﬁle storage subsystem design and implementation.
* High load storage for unique user proﬁles (thousands of lookups per second on single 8 core
CPU, total capacity 10M+ of users).
* Trafﬁc booking system prototype.

Education
Moscow State Aviation Technological University
2007 MA (Hons) Engineering and technology science
2005 BA (Hons) Engineering and technology science
